info.title: SapoClone - platform service
info.description: OpenAPI specification of the platform microservice

tags.name: admin-auth
tags.description: Platform-admin sign-in, refresh and sign-out. Login is public; the rest needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `post /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: admin-tenants
tags.description: Stores: list, create, edit, suspend and reactivate. Needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: admin-accounts
tags.description: Store users' accounts and their sessions. Needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: admin-admins
tags.description: Platform administrators (super admin only). Needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: admin-plans
tags.description: Subscription plans and their limits. Needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: admin-subscriptions
tags.description: Store subscriptions, payments and plan changes. Needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: admin-usage
tags.description: Usage of each store against its plan limits. Needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: admin-settings
tags.description: Platform-wide settings. Needs an admin token (`sub_type = platform_admin`, from `POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login`); a store token is refused.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Store sign-in, registration, token refresh and switching the selected store

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: The signed-in user's own account, password and sessions

tags.name: tenants
tags.description: Stores: the current store, its members and invitations

tags.name: staff-schedules
tags.description: Work shifts and who is on duty

details.description: Field errors of a 422, or the facts of a 409 such as the plan limit (`key`, `used`, `limit`, `planCode`)

tenantId.description: Store to select; omitted -> the only store, or none
Selected store, or null when the caller must pick or create one

subdomain.description: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; 3–30 chars; cannot change later

defaultBranchName.description: D10: the name of the first branch; `Chi nhánh chính` when omitted

permissions.description: The token's permissions; the owner's `*` is listed as every code of the catalog

branchIds.description: Branches the member may act in; empty means every branch

onShift.description: Active members with a shift running now (store timezone)

defaultRoleCount.description: The seeded roles every store starts with (5)

dataScope.description: The store name: the data scope of the list

branchIds.description: Branches the member may act in; empty means every branch

AssignableRole.description: Legacy name of the role (`manager`, `cashier`, ...); `roleId` wins when both are sent

email.description: The account to add; it must already have registered

roleId.description: The role to give (`GET /roles`); one of `roleId` and `role` is required

role.description: Legacy name of the role (`manager`, `cashier`, ...); `roleId` wins when both are sent

branchIds.description: Branches the member may act in; omit or send none for every branch

role.description: Legacy name of the role (`manager`, `cashier`, ...); `roleId` wins when both are sent

branchIds.description: The full set of branches: it replaces the old one; an empty list means every branch

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday; one row is created per day

duty.description: What the member is in charge of in this shift; `sales` when left out

code.description: Uppercase letters, digits, _ and -; unique within the store
Stable code: appears in the token's `roles` claim and in events

key.description: The code of a seeded role, null for a custom role (contract field)

code.description: Stable code: appears in the token's `roles` claim and in events

key.description: The code of a seeded role, null for a custom role (contract field)

permissions.description: Permission codes; the owner role lists every code of the catalog
The full set of permission codes: it replaces the old one

actions.description: The actions that exist for this module

isApplicable.description: False for module/action pairs that do not exist (the UI shows a dash)

permissions.description: Every module x action pair, flagged when it exists

defaults.description: Default permission matrix of the five seeded roles (owner lists every code)

planCode.description: The plan the store starts on; `free` when omitted. An inactive plan answers P001

password.description:
Not in contract 04, which queues a set-password email: there is no email flow for admins, so without a password
the new admin cannot sign in. Same policy as the bootstrap command.

currency.description: The platform bills in dong only

graceDays.description: Days a paid plan keeps its limits after it ended, before it falls back to `free` (0 = no grace)
